_readme: The CEO's Linear user ids, for the Green Light reply phase (DRE-6138).
scripts/green_light_reply.py sends an epic waiting in Green Light back
for a review once per comment in the CEO's voice. A console answer is
his voice by its signature, and needs nothing here. A comment typed
straight into Linear is his only when its author's Linear user id is in
It ships EMPTY on purpose: an empty list means no Linear comment counts
as his, so nothing fails open and no build agent had to know the id. The
operator fills it in by hand. A file that does not hold a list of ids
stops the phase rather than reading as empty.
tests/test_green_light_reply.py reads this file as shipped.
